Welcome to the AI Evaluation/Auditing Task
Thank you for taking part in this study. Please read the following information carefully before you begin.
Information about the AI system you are about to evaluate/audit
The AI system in this study generates descriptions of cultural heritage artefacts.
For each artefact, the AI system uses an artefact image and structured metadata to produce a written description. Your task is to review what should be checked to decide whether those descriptions are accurate, complete, culturally appropriate, and free from harmful assumptions or misrepresentation.
What data is the AI system using?
TimeTravel Cultural Heritage Collection: The dataset contains museum artefact records structured as image-text pairs. Each record includes an artefact image, metadata such as materials, provenance, production date, and cultural context, plus an AI-generated description.

For this study, you will work with a sample of artefact records drawn from the original dataset.

Build your metric
This step has two tabs: 1. Guided Metrics: Select AI metrics that you think are important for assessing the AI system. 2. Recorded Concerns: Record any concerns or observations you have about the AI system, the data, or its behaviour.
Notice, the tool will use your selections to create a clear statement describing what should be measured below.
After creating a metric, click Save Metric. Your metric will not be saved automatically. You can create and save as many metrics and concerns as you wish. When you have finished, click Next.
